model_annotation: The image displays three donut charts illustrating the distribution of enterprises, employment, and turnover by industry, construction, trade, and other services in 2021, based on NACE Rev. 2 classification. Each chart is divided into four colored segments corresponding to the sectors: industry (yellow), construction (blue), trade (red), and other services (dark blue). The leftmost chart, labeled "NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES," shows industry at 8% (2.4 million), construction at 12% (3.7 million), trade at 19% (5.9 million), and other services at 61% (19.0 million). The middle chart, "NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED," indicates industry at 21% (33.0 million), construction at 9% (13.4 million), trade at 19% (29.5 million), and other services at 51% (80.2 million). The rightmost chart, "TURNOVER," presents industry at 33% (10.6 billion), construction at 6% (1.9 billion), trade at 31% (9.5 billion), and other services at 31% (9.8 billion). All charts include percentage values and absolute figures within their respective segments, and a legend at the bottom left identifies the color coding for each sector. The charts are arranged side by side with a slight diagonal tilt, and no segments are visually emphasized or rearranged beyond their natural proportional size.
